"""Audit all streamed bindings and the preselected36 native RGB/RAW cases."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics
from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar
from demosaic.nonlocal_raw import NonlocalRawDemosaic
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V170-nonlocal-raw-v2'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);result=read(root/'scores-v1.json');design=read(plan['design']['path'])
supp=read(repo/'docs/results/v170-runtime-dependency-preparation-v1.json')
events=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
journal=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'observations-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(events)==len(journal)==822 and result['counts']==dict(root=822,network=822,sampler=4110)
assert result['module_before']==result['module_after'] and result['RNG_unchanged']
module=NonlocalRawDemosaic().load_released_state(plan['released_weights']['path']);assert model_hash(module)==result['module_before']
assert len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters())==15282866
metric=DetailMetrics(plan['metrics_sources']);rows={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in result['rows']};raw_rows={r['id']:r for r in result['raw_rows']}
inputs=scalars=rgb_count=raw_count=reconstructed_channels=0;maximum=maximum_dn=maximum_sample=0.;metric_fields=0

def cfa(value,colors):
 return np.stack([value[0,int(colors[0,p]),p//2::2,p%2::2] for p in range(4)])[None]

for ordinal,index in enumerate(plan['processing_order']):
 case=design['observations'][index];event=events[ordinal];record=journal[ordinal]
 assert event['index']==record['index']==index and event['id']==record['id']==case['id']
 assert event['ordinal']==ordinal and event['returned_forwards']==event['network_forwards']==ordinal+1 and event['nested_sampler_calls']==5*(ordinal+1)
 assert record['arrays']==case['arrays'] and record['parent']==case['parent']
 assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
 a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(case['parent']['path'])
 for field,f in record['inputs'].items():assert fingerprint(a[field])==f;inputs+=1
 assert sorted(record['rows'],key=lambda r:r['method'])==[rows[case['id'],m] for m in sorted(plan['methods'])]
 assert record['raw']==raw_rows[case['id']]
 maximum_sample=max(maximum_sample,*record['raw']['measured_sample_maximum_error'].values())
 assert maximum_sample<5e-7
 if case['id'] not in result['native_predictions']:continue
 bindings=result['native_predictions'][case['id']];b=bindings['denoised-RAW'];assert ref(b['path'])==b
 raw=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(raw)==record['raw']['values'] and np.isfinite(raw).all() and raw.min()>=0 and raw.max()<=1;raw_count+=1
 if case['kind']!='real':
  target=cfa(a['target'],a['colors'])
  for field,value in [('raw_error_RMS_DN16',raw),('noisy_error_RMS_DN16',a['packed'])]:
   expected=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((value.astype(np.float64)-target)**2))*65535)
   assert abs(expected-record['raw'][field])<1e-10;scalars+=1
 direct=noisy_malvar(dict(a,packed=raw))
 residual=(raw-cfa(base,a['colors'])).astype(np.float32)
 hybrid=base.astype(np.float64)+noisy_malvar(dict(a,packed=residual))
 for method,expected in [('NLRaw-Malvar',direct),('NLRaw-DINO',hybrid)]:
  b=bindings[method];assert ref(b['path'])==b
  value=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(value)==rows[case['id'],method]['values']
  measured=float(np.max(np.abs(cfa(value,a['colors'])-raw)));assert measured==record['raw']['measured_sample_maximum_error'][method]
  measured_error=np.abs(value.astype(np.float64)-expected)
  # Independent NumPy64 interpolation vs Torch FP32; a forward-error bound,
  # including weighted sums/division and signed residual addition, no learned calls.
  magnitude=np.maximum(np.max(np.abs(raw)),np.max(np.abs(base)))
  bound=32*np.finfo(np.float32).eps*max(float(magnitude),1e-6)*max(1.,float(np.max(a['wb'])/np.min(a['wb'])))
  assert measured_error.max()<=bound,(case['id'],method,float(measured_error.max()),bound)
  maximum=max(maximum,float(measured_error.max()));maximum_dn=max(maximum_dn,float(measured_error.max())*65535);reconstructed_channels+=measured_error.size
  actual=metric.measure(case,a,base,value)
  for field,v in actual.items():
   if isinstance(v,(float,int)) and not isinstance(v,bool):assert abs(v-rows[case['id'],method][field])<1e-10;scalars+=1;metric_fields+=1
  rgb_count+=1
assert inputs==3288 and rgb_count==72 and raw_count==36
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root/'independent-audit-v1.json',dict(status='pass-all-stream-bindings-and-selected-native-arrays',plan=ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),scores=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),runtime_dependency_preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v170-runtime-dependency-preparation-v1.json'),
 actual_forward_events=822,completed_observation_events=822,nested_quality_sampling_calls=4110,streamed_method_rows_checked=1644,input_fingerprints_checked=inputs,
 strict_checkpoint_tensors=141,strict_checkpoint_parameters=15282866,module_hash=model_hash(module),saved_native_RGB_checked=rgb_count,saved_native_RAW_checked=raw_count,
 scalar_checks=scalars,native_metric_fields=metric_fields,independent_NumPy_reconstructed_channels=reconstructed_channels,maximum_reconstruction_error=maximum,maximum_reconstruction_error_DN16=maximum_dn,
 allcase_maximum_measured_CFA_error=maximum_sample,forward_journal=ref(root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl'),observation_journal=ref(root/'observations-v1.jsonl'),new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,
 source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope='All822 input/parent file bindings,3288 actual input fingerprints,822 actual root/network events/4110 nested calls,and1644 RGB rows match durable journals. Independent posthoc array/metric/RAW-to-RGB reconstruction covers only36 preselected native cases:72 RGB+36 RAW arrays. All other new outputs were scored/fingerprinted and norm/decomposition checked in process but not retained;no full new-array posthoc audit is claimed.'))
print('PASS822 event/input bindings;72 RGB/36 RAW;scalars',scalars,'channels',reconstructed_channels,'maxNumPyDN',maximum_dn)
